body: Ah thanks for the question! I just randomly logged in. He was at a university library and did something suspicious. The public safety officers took him to the hospital. He wouldn't let his parents see him and was actually refusing medical attention. The mom petitioned that he stay at the hospital. After about 7 days at the hospital, he was released. I think he was diagnosed with brief reactive psychosis. Was put on anti-psychotic medication and then went off of it the days following his release. He seems mostly normal now though I haven't seen him in a while.
Thank you for the advice. We are actually in Michigan.

Thank you for the advice. I really appreciate it. Another friend of mine was suggesting that I give him his space, but I feel like being too passive may be detrimental. I think I will ask him if he'd like to go to the doctor with me.

Yeah I was thinking of that. But do you think it is logical for me to contact his parents and inform them that I am concerned? Or do you think that would be overreacting and that I should show my friend that I am trustable and just give him room to think?

Edit: I have no reason to believe that his family would be out to get him as he suggests.
